nodes.long_description:
1. Pick up the firewood around you and add it to the campfire to make it grow.
2. Catch the fireflies flying around you.
3. Hold the stick and beat the drum to make the fireflies dance.
4. Roast marshmallows by placing them around the campfire.
5. Throw the colored powder into the campfire to change the color of the flames.
nodes.short_description: A content experience set in a relaxing camping-themed VR environment where users can enjoy rest and sensory relaxation while completing various activities. Users focus on visual and auditory stimuli within the campsite and participate in interactive tasks to naturally train attention, instruction-following skills, judgment, and cognitive abilities.
